core_meaning.primary_meaning: The Arabic word عَالَم (ʿālam) means “world” or “the created realm.” Its use as a personal name, and any claims about how common it is or which genders use it, require separate naming-usage evidence.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: The Arabic form عَالَم (ʿālam) denotes the world or created realm; the Cairo Arabic Language Academy's Al-Wasīṭ dictionary defines it as all creation and as a class of created things. Lane's Arabic-English Lexicon also records world/creation senses for العَالَم. These lexical sources support the word's Arabic dictionary meaning, but do not by themselves establish frequency, gender distribution, or attestation as a modern given name.

etymology.false_etymology_warning: No derivation beyond the documented Arabic form is asserted. Any etymology that attributes this spelling to a different root or language without a source should be treated as unverified.
